Chat Application

聊天应用

Designing a Chat Application

In Chapter 6, we explored multiple networking protocols and communication mechanisms for building near real-time messaging platforms. Messaging applications are widely used across the globe. The application can be standalone, such as WhatsApp or Telegram, or it can be integrated as a feature inside social networking apps like LinkedIn or Instagram. In this chapter, we’ll learn how to design large-scale messaging applications to offer fast communication in near real time. We’ll also discuss the underlying architecture of WhatsApp messenger, which serves a huge number of concurrent users. Let’s begin with the system requirements of a chat application.

在第 6 章中，我们探讨了多种用于构建近实时消息平台的网络协议与通信机制。消息应用在全球范围内被广泛使用。这类应用可以是独立的，例如 WhatsApp 或 Telegram，也可以作为一项功能集成在 LinkedIn 或 Instagram 等社交网络应用内部。在本章中，我们将学习如何设计大规模消息应用，以近实时的方式提供快速通信。我们还会讨论 WhatsApp messenger 的底层架构，它服务着数量极其庞大的并发用户。我们从聊天应用的系统需求开始。

System Requirements

A messaging application can support a wide variety of features, but to keep it simple, we will choose to build a limited set of functionalities and skip features like voice and video calling. Let’s finalize the requirements to answer these questions:

消息应用可以支持各种各样的功能，但为简单起见，我们选择构建一小组有限的功能，并跳过语音通话和视频通话等功能。让我们通过回答以下问题来确定需求：

What kinds of communication are supported by the application?

The application offers one-to-one messaging, group messaging, and broadcast messaging. A broadcast is different from group messaging in that only a subset of users can send messages in the broadcast channel.

应用提供一对一消息、群组消息和广播消息。广播与群组消息的不同之处在于：在广播频道中，只有一部分用户可以发送消息。

What type of content will be supported by the application?

The application allows users to share text messages, images, videos, and documents. The next question that arises is whether there is a limit to the video file size. To avoid large media uploads, the system limits the file size to 100 MB.

应用允许用户分享文本消息、图片、视频和文档。接下来出现的问题是：视频文件大小是否有限制。为避免上传过大的媒体文件，系统将文件大小限制为 100 MB。

Does the application store all the messages on its end, or are messages deleted once they are delivered to the users?

We’ll build a system like WhatsApp that can delete the messages from the server once the messages are delivered to the users.

我们将构建一个类似 WhatsApp 的系统，一旦消息被送达用户，就可以从服务器上删除这些消息。

Page 523

Will the system include read receipts?

Reflecting the user last seen and read receipts for any messages sent is a good feature to have. The read receipts can include messages sent to the application server, delivered to the user, and read by the user.

展示用户的最后在线时间以及已发送消息的已读回执，是一个很好的功能。已读回执可以包括：消息已发送到应用服务器、消息已送达用户、消息已被用户阅读。

Does the system support end-to-end encryption of messages?

Encryption ensures that the messages can be read only by the sender and the receiver, which maintains their security. We’ll skip the implementation details of encryption support, but the system will not be limited in any way from offering this support in the future.

加密保证消息只能被发送方和接收方阅读，从而维护其安全性。我们将跳过加密支持的实现细节，但系统在未来提供这种支持方面不会受到任何限制。

Is there a limit on the number of members in a group or for message broadcasts?

We’ll limit the system to 1,024 members for a group and for broadcast messages. In broadcast channels, only people with admin access can message, and the rest of the group can only view the message. We’re not imposing any limits on the number of people who can be admins—note that if everyone is an admin, then the broadcast channel essentially behaves as a group.

我们将把系统限制为一个群组和广播消息最多 1,024 名成员。在广播频道中，只有拥有管理员权限的人才能发消息，群组中的其他人只能查看消息。我们不对可以担任管理员的人数施加任何限制——请注意，如果每个人都是管理员，那么广播频道本质上就表现得像一个普通群组。

Does the application support features apart from messaging, such as voice calls, video calls, or sharing status updates (like Instagram stories) with the users?

The application focuses just on the chat functionality and doesn’t support any extra features.

应用只专注于聊天功能，不支持任何额外功能。

Let’s turn to the functional and nonfunctional requirements of the system.

下面我们转向系统的功能性需求和非功能性需求。

Functional and Nonfunctional Requirements

The functional features supported by the chat application are:

聊天应用支持的功能性特性包括：

  • The application supports one-to-one, group, and broadcast messages.
    应用支持一对一、群组和广播消息。
  • Text, images, videos, and documents are supported as media types for communication among the users.
    支持文本、图片、视频和文档作为用户之间通信的媒体类型。
  • A user should be able to see active status (online/offline) and last seen of any person from their contacts.
    用户应当能够看到其联系人中任何人的在线状态（在线/离线）和最后在线时间。
  • Read receipts should be shown for sent, delivered, and read messages.
    对于已发送、已送达和已阅读的消息，应当显示已读回执。
  • There are push notifications on users’ mobile devices for their received messages.
    用户的移动设备上会针对收到的消息推送通知。

Let’s discuss the NFRs next:

下面我们讨论非功能性需求（NFR）：

  • The communication should be near real time with minimum possible latency.
    通信应当是近实时的，并具有尽可能低的延迟。
  • The system should be highly available and able to operate at increasing scale.
    系统应当高可用，并能够在规模不断增长的情况下持续运行。
Page 524
  • The system should be able to store chat messages until they are delivered to recipients.
    系统应当能够存储聊天消息，直到这些消息被送达接收方。

We’ll make some assumptions and try to come up with an expected scale for the system in the next section.

我们将在接下来的一节中做一些假设，并尝试给出系统的预期规模。

System Scale

For the scale that needs to be supported by the system, we can make assumptions based on the scale served by the WhatsApp chat application:

对于系统需要支持的规模，我们可以基于 WhatsApp 聊天应用所服务的规模做出假设：

  • Number of monthly active users = 3 billion
    月活跃用户数 = 30 亿
  • Messages sent = 100 billion/day = 1.2 million/second
    发送消息数 = 1000 亿条/天 = 120 万条/秒
  • Text, images, videos sent every day = 90 billion text, 8 billion images, 2 billion videos
    每天发送的文本、图片、视频 = 900 亿条文本、80 亿张图片、20 亿个视频

The chat application supports both one-to-one and group messaging. The write-to-read-ratio is approximately 1:1 for direct messaging between two users, and it will be skewed in the case of group messaging. There are no stats available for the number of groups on the WhatsApp platform, so let’s take a rough number of one billion. There are generally very few active users sending messages in the groups, and the remaining users are readers only; a good assumption for the read-to-write ratio is 90:10.

聊天应用同时支持一对一消息和群组消息。对于两个用户之间的直接消息，写读比约为 1:1；而在群组消息的情况下，这个比例会发生倾斜。WhatsApp 平台上群组数量没有公开统计数据，我们粗略取一个数字：10 亿。群组中通常只有极少数活跃用户在发消息，其余用户只是阅读者；读写字比取 90:10 是一个合理的假设。

The numbers indicate the large number of concurrent users that the system is required to handle, and the system should be horizontally scalable to work without hiccups for peak overloads. The number of connections that a single server can handle highly depends on the choice of implementation and should be figured out with proper load testing. We’ll go into more detail on the implementation next.

这些数字表明系统需要处理数量极其庞大的并发用户，系统应当可水平扩展，以便在峰值过载时也能平稳运行而不出岔子。单台服务器能处理的连接数在很大程度上取决于实现方式，应当通过恰当的负载测试来确定。下面我们将更详细地讨论实现。

Starting with the Design

In a very simplistic view of a chat application, a user sends a message to the chat server with the intended recipient, and the chat server delivers this message to the receiver as shown in Figure 19-1. The chat message might be intermittently stored in the database in case the user is not connected to the internet.

以一个非常简化的视角来看聊天应用：用户把消息连同预期接收方一起发送给聊天服务器，聊天服务器再把这条消息投递给接收方，如图 19-1 所示。如果用户没有连接到互联网，聊天消息可能会被临时存储在数据库中。

The first step before communication can begin between users is registering the user and determining who they can send messages to. This can completely vary from use case to use case; for example, you need a person’s registered phone number for communication over WhatsApp and an Instagram handle for communication over Instagram. Here, we’ll take our cues from WhatsApp and use the phone number as a unique identifier for user registration. The user is verified via a phone number, and reregistration is required if their phone number changes. The user service can be

在用户之间开始通信之前，第一步是注册用户并确定他们可以给谁发消息。这一点因用例而异，完全不同；例如，在 WhatsApp 上通信需要对方注册过的电话号码，而在 Instagram 上通信则需要对方的 Instagram 账号。这里我们效仿 WhatsApp，使用电话号码作为用户注册的唯一标识符。用户通过电话号码进行验证，如果电话号码变更，则需要重新注册。用户服务可以

Page 525

responsible for registering a user and later for authentication of the user to send and receive messages.

负责注册用户，并在之后负责对用户进行认证，以收发消息。

Now, let’s look at the messaging architecture and figure out details like optimal networking protocol and message storage selection.

现在，我们来看消息架构，并弄清楚诸如最佳网络协议和消息存储选择之类的细节。

Messaging Architecture

A very important requirement for messaging systems is near real-time behavior: the communication should be instant, as if two people are talking face-to-face. To support this, it is critical to identify the networking protocol (or technology). Some popular protocols are XMPP and MQTT. Refer to Chapter 6 for the architectural details of these protocols. Let’s try to figure out the benefits associated with each of these protocols.

消息系统一个非常重要的需求是近实时行为：通信应当是即时的，就像两个人面对面交谈一样。为支持这一点，关键是要选定网络协议（或技术）。一些流行的协议是 XMPP 和 MQTT。这些协议的架构细节请参阅第 6 章。下面我们尝试弄清楚每种协议各自带来的好处。

Protocol selection

Based on the discussion from Chapter 6, the chat system requires implementation of WebSockets for maintaining a persistent connection between the users and the chat servers. The other mechanisms for retrieving new messages (such as polling) from the chat server are latency and resource-intensive operations (see “Scaling post comments” on page 430 in Chapter 16). Since a persistent connection is maintained, the protocol must be lightweight to ensure that resource consumption by devices is minimum (saving internet usage and battery life).

基于第 6 章的讨论，聊天系统需要实现 WebSocket，以在用户与聊天服务器之间维持一条持久连接。从聊天服务器拉取新消息的其他机制（例如轮询）都是延迟高、资源消耗大的操作（参见第 16 章第 430 页的“扩展帖子评论”）。由于维持了持久连接，协议必须轻量，以确保设备的资源消耗最小（节省流量和电池续航）。

Another important point to consider for fast messaging over the network is message payload size, which can heavily depend on the data format. The payload in JSON format can be bulky; one solution to reduce it could be data compression, and another involves using data formats like Thrift or Protocol Buffers (Protobuf).
要在网络上实现快速消息传输，另一个需要考虑的重要点是消息载荷大小，而这在很大程度上取决于数据格式。JSON 格式的载荷可能很臃肿；减小载荷的一个办法是数据压缩，另一个办法是使用 Thrift 或 Protocol Buffers（Protobuf）等数据格式。
Page 526

Assume a user connects to the internet and the chat application establishes a connection with the chat server over HTTPS. There can be two possible approaches here:

假设用户连上互联网，聊天应用通过 HTTPS 与聊天服务器建立连接。这里有两种可能的方案：

  • The first call pulls all the user’s messages since they were last online and then establishes a persistent bidirectional connection to receive any delta updates.
    第一次调用拉取自用户上次在线以来的所有消息，然后建立一条持久的双向连接，用于接收任何增量更新。
  • The first call registers the user on the chat server, and then all messages (since they were offline or new messages) are sent over a persistent bidirectional connection.
    第一次调用在聊天服务器上注册用户，然后所有消息（自离线以来的消息或新消息）都通过一条持久的双向连接发送。

Both the MQTT and XMPP protocols are widely used by different messaging applications to support a large scale of users: MQTT is used by Facebook Messenger, and XMPP is used by WhatsApp. XMPP is inherently built to support messaging, and MQTT is built especially for machine-to-machine communication in resource-constrained environments. Both protocols are lightweight, but MQTT is relatively lighter and operates on the transport layer. XMPP is more feature rich in terms of messaging architecture as compared to MQTT but requires more resources for operating.

MQTT 和 XMPP 这两种协议都被不同的消息应用广泛使用，以支持大规模用户：Facebook Messenger 使用 MQTT，WhatsApp 使用 XMPP。XMPP 天生就是为支持消息传递而构建的，而 MQTT 则特别为资源受限环境下的机器对机器通信而构建。两种协议都很轻量，但 MQTT 相对更轻，工作在传输层。在消息架构方面，XMPP 比 MQTT 功能更丰富，但运行时需要更多资源。

There is also the option of not using either XMPP or MQTT but instead relying on a pure WebSocket connection over HTTPS between the client devices and the server. This will definitely introduce additional work on the system’s end, which could have been inherently supported by a particular protocol, such as user presence information in the case of XMPP. These protocols can also work with persistent connections, and it is a good idea to use them in order to gain their inherent properties and build on top of them. We’ll now try to figure out the system architectural details for building one-to-one chat functionality.

还有一种选择是既不使用 XMPP 也不使用 MQTT，而是依赖客户端设备与服务器之间一条基于 HTTPS 的纯 WebSocket 连接。这无疑会在系统端引入额外的工作，而这些工作本可以由某个特定协议天生支持——例如 XMPP 中的用户在线状态信息。这些协议同样可以与持久连接配合使用，因此使用它们以获得其固有特性并在其上进行构建，是个不错的主意。下面我们尝试弄清楚构建一对一聊天功能的系统架构细节。

Direct messaging

In the previous section, we mentioned keeping a bidirectional persistent connection between the user and the chat application server. For a user to send a message to another user, the system should be able to figure out which particular server (from the pool of servers) holds the connection for that user. Message delivery from user A to user B can be completed in this series of steps, shown in Figure 19-2:

在上一节中，我们提到要在用户与聊天应用服务器之间维持一条双向持久连接。当一个用户要给另一个用户发消息时，系统应当能够弄清楚（从服务器池中）哪一台特定服务器持有该用户的连接。从用户 A 到用户 B 的消息投递可以通过下面这一系列步骤完成，如图 19-2 所示：

  1. User A sends a connection request to the chat frontend service once the device is online.
    设备一旦上线，用户 A 就向聊天前端服务发送连接请求。
  2. The chat frontend service authenticates the user by forwarding the request to the user service.
    聊天前端服务通过把请求转发给用户服务来对用户进行认证。
  3. The system establishes a persistent connection with the user device and stores an entry in the database of the server ID assigned to the user device.
    系统与用户设备建立持久连接，并在数据库中存储一条记录，记录分配给该用户设备的服务器 ID。
  4. Steps 1 and 2 occur for user B.
    对用户 B 执行步骤 1 和步骤 2。
Page 527
  1. User A sends a message to the chat frontend service with user B as the intended recipient.
    用户 A 向聊天前端服务发送一条消息，接收方为用户 B。
  2. The system checks for the server ID assigned to user B from the database in case user B is online and sends the message to user B’s device.
    如果用户 B 在线，系统从数据库中查出分配给用户 B 的服务器 ID，并把消息发送到用户 B 的设备。
  3. Once the message is delivered to user B’s device, the system sends an acknowledgment over the same persistent bidirectional connection, which is forwarded to user A’s device. The message-read acknowledgment works in the same way.
    一旦消息送达用户 B 的设备，系统就在同一条持久双向连接上发送一个确认，并把该确认转发给用户 A 的设备。消息已读确认的工作方式与此相同。

When both users who are communicating are online, there is no requirement for message storage, and the message can be delivered directly to the intended recipient. In case the recipient is offline, the system maintains an independent offline component to store the messages for the time being. The database of user IDs to server IDs also includes information noting if the user is online or when the user was last active. This can be served with a simple key-value database, such as Amazon DynamoDB or Amazon ElastiCache with Redis storing metadata information for users, as shown in Figure 19-3. In a nutshell, we need a connection management mechanism for a

当通信双方都在线时，就不需要消息存储，消息可以直接投递给预期接收方。如果接收方离线，系统会维护一个独立的离线组件来临时存储消息。用户 ID 到服务器 ID 的数据库中还包含信息，记录用户是否在线、以及用户上次活跃的时间。这可以用一个简单的键值数据库来提供，例如 Amazon DynamoDB，或者用 Amazon ElastiCache（基于 Redis）存储用户的元数据信息，如图 19-3 所示。简而言之，我们需要一个连接管理机制，用于管理

Page 528

very high number of concurrent users and to figure out a way to manage the users to different servers efficiently.

数量极其庞大的并发用户，并找到一种方法把这些用户高效地分配到不同服务器上。

The system should be able to handle network interruptions. Let’s say the internet is jittery, which causes the connection with the server to drop intermittently. This can lead to continuous fluctuation of a user’s presence status between online and offline. The system can handle this via periodic heartbeats at a fixed interval with the user device to make sure the device is still connected with the chat server.
系统应当能够处理网络中断。假设网络抖动，导致与服务器的连接间歇性断开。这会导致用户的在线状态在在线与离线之间不断波动。系统可以通过按固定间隔与用户设备周期性心跳来处理这种情况，以确认设备仍然连接着聊天服务器。

The user connection should be managed by a thread or process on the running server, and to ensure a single server can support a huge number of connections, the process/thread should be lightweight. The OS processes are not really lightweight, so we’ll explore some alternatives on top of them to help with this implementation in the system architecture.

用户连接应当由运行中的服务器上的一个线程或进程来管理；为确保单台服务器能支撑数量庞大的连接，该进程/线程必须轻量。操作系统进程并不真正轻量，因此我们将探索在其之上的一些替代方案，以在系统架构中帮助实现这一点。

The actor model is a conceptual model proposed to support large numbers of connections concurrently with minimal resources. The actor model can be inherently supported by the programming language, or we can use available frameworks or libraries built for the programming language. We’ll talk about the Erlang programming language with support for the actor model as Erlang processes in the “WhatsApp Architecture” section. There are similar implementations in other languages, such as goroutines in Go, coroutines in Kotlin, and virtual threads in Java.

Actor 模型是一个概念模型，旨在用最少的资源并发支持大量连接。Actor 模型可以由编程语言原生支持，或者我们可以使用为该编程语言构建的现成框架或库。我们将在“WhatsApp 架构”一节中讨论 Erlang 编程语言，它以 Erlang 进程的形式支持 actor 模型。其他语言中也有类似实现，例如 Go 中的 goroutine、Kotlin 中的协程（coroutine）以及 Java 中的虚拟线程（virtual thread）。

The actor model can be helpful for managing a large number of user connections. Akka is one of the actor model implementations for the Java and Scala programming languages, and Play framework is a utility that can be used to manage implementation of the Akka actor model with WebSockets to facilitate the messaging functionality. Using these frameworks in software programs helps us build the applications on top of the actor model and reduces our work since we don’t have to build everything from scratch.

Actor 模型有助于管理大量用户连接。Akka 是面向 Java 和 Scala 编程语言的一种 actor 模型实现，而 Play 框架是一个工具，可用于结合 WebSocket 管理 Akka actor 模型的实现，以便实现消息功能。在软件程序中使用这些框架，能帮助我们在 actor 模型之上构建应用，并减少工作量，因为我们不必从零开始构建一切。

Page 529

Here are the characteristics of the actor model:

下面是 actor 模型的特点：

  • An actor is a very small object and acts as a fundamental unit of computation in the system.
    actor 是一个非常小的对象，充当系统中最基本的计算单元。
  • Each actor is isolated and doesn’t share memory with other actors. This feature helps with managing the concurrent connections very easily without a requirement of explicit locking for resources.
    每个 actor 都是隔离的，不与其他 actor 共享内存。这一特性帮助非常轻松地管理并发连接，而不需要对资源显式加锁。
  • Each actor has a designated mailbox (FIFO queue) to receive messages from other actors that serves as a communication channel between the actors.
    每个 actor 都有一个指定的邮箱（FIFO 队列），用于接收来自其他 actor 的消息，充当 actor 之间的通信通道。
  • An actor is associated with a state and behavior. The behavior defines the state modification logic upon receiving a new message.
    actor 关联着一个状态和一组行为。行为定义了在收到新消息时对状态进行修改的逻辑。
  • Actors are completely decoupled to work asynchronously and handle one message at a time. To perform the required work, an actor is assigned a lightweight thread to modify the state based on behavior definition from the message. The great thing about this architectural pattern is that threads are not blocked for the entire request execution (as in synchronous systems). The thread is free as soon as work by the actor is complete, and the thread can be assigned to other actors. This allows the system to create a lot more actors (with the same hardware configurations) and execute them with fewer threads, optimizing the overall resource utilization of the system.
    actor 之间完全解耦，异步工作，每次处理一条消息。为完成所需工作，会给 actor 分配一个轻量线程，根据消息中的行为定义来修改状态。这种架构模式的妙处在于：线程不会像同步系统那样在整个请求执行期间被阻塞。actor 的工作一完成，线程就立即释放，可以被分配给其他 actor。这使得系统（在相同硬件配置下）可以创建多得多的 actor，并用更少的线程来执行它们，从而优化系统的整体资源利用率。
  • An actor can create child actors and supervise them with the operation (act as a supervisor actor). The supervision handles failures at the topmost layer in case work being executed fails for some reason.
    actor 可以创建子 actor，并在运行中监督它们（充当监督者 actor）。当正在执行的工作因某种原因失败时，监督机制会在最顶层处理这些失败。

The ratio of the number of actors to threads can vary by a huge proportion on a single machine. In reference to the chat application architecture, each actor is responsible for holding one persistent connection with a user device, but a thread is assigned to the actor only when a message is being sent to the device. The first connection between users is established as a simple HTTPS call from the user device, and then it is converted to persistent connection. The chat frontend service stores the configuration of which particular instance is being assigned to the user from the pool.

在单台机器上，actor 数量与线程数量之比可以相差非常大。对应到聊天应用架构，每个 actor 负责维持与一个用户设备的一条持久连接，但只有在向该设备发送消息时，才会给这个 actor 分配一个线程。用户之间的第一条连接是由用户设备发起一次简单的 HTTPS 调用建立的，随后才转换为持久连接。聊天前端服务会存储配置：从连接池中把哪一个特定实例分配给了该用户。

A machine may go down while it’s managing the user connections. There should be an efficient mechanism to reestablish the connection with user devices without having much impact on the chat application and user experience. This requires spawning a new machine, reestablishing user connections, and updating the user mapping database with a new instance. The establishment of a new connection can be built inside the client application to check for the persistent connection (in case the device is connected to the internet), and if the connection is dropped, the client can initiate a new connection with the server, and the server accordingly reassigns a new actor on a machine and updates the user mapping database.

一台机器在管理用户连接时可能宕机。应当有一个高效的机制来与用户设备重新建立连接，而对聊天应用和用户体验没有太大影响。这需要启动一台新机器、重建用户连接、并用新实例更新用户映射数据库。新连接的建立可以内置在客户端应用中：检查持久连接是否还在（前提是设备已联网）；如果连接断开，客户端可以向服务器发起新连接，服务器随之在某台机器上重新分配一个新的 actor，并更新用户映射数据库。

Page 530

The one-to-one message functionality can be extended to group and broadcast messages with one difference: the chat frontend service forwards the message request from the user to the group service, and then this service fans out the messages to the group members. In case some users from the group are not available, messages should be kept in the transient storage until the users come back online.

一对一消息功能可以扩展到群组消息和广播消息，区别只有一点：聊天前端服务把用户发来的消息请求转发给群组服务，然后由该服务把消息扇出（fan out）给群组成员。如果群组中有些用户不在线，消息应保存在临时存储中，直到这些用户重新上线。

The system doesn’t continuously check for a user’s online status; rather, it relies on the user’s initial ping to establish connection. Upon establishing the first connection, the system checks for any new messages from when the user was offline and delivers them if there’s anything present in the database.
系统不会持续检查用户的在线状态；相反，它依赖用户首次发起的 ping 来建立连接。建立第一条连接时，系统会检查用户离线期间是否有任何新消息，如果数据库中存有消息，就把它们投递出去。

Let’s move on to discuss our data store requirements for storing messages and multimedia for offline users.

下面我们继续讨论为离线用户存储消息和多媒体内容的数据存储需求。

Message storage

The system supports text, image, and video formats. An object storage data store such as Amazon S3 is a good choice for storing large media files like images, videos, or any other types of documents. For text messaging and references to media files, we can use more structured databases, such as RDBMS or any NoSQL solution. The requirements for the database are simple:

系统支持文本、图片和视频格式。像 Amazon S3 这样的对象存储数据存储，是存储图片、视频或任何其他类型文档等大型媒体文件的好选择。对于文本消息以及对媒体文件的引用，我们可以使用更具结构化的数据库，例如 RDBMS 或任何 NoSQL 方案。对数据库的需求很简单：

  • Store messages in such a way that they can be retrieved once the user is connected to the chat servers. This should serve all kinds of messaging: one-to-one, group, and broadcast.
    以这样一种方式存储消息：一旦用户连上聊天服务器，就能把它们检索出来。这应当服务于所有类型的消息：一对一、群组和广播。
  • Messages should be stored with acknowledgment receipts until the messages are seen by the recipient.
    消息应当连同已读回执一起存储，直到接收方看到这些消息。

The data should be stored in the database in such a way that the reads are very fast, meaning the system should be able to retrieve all the direct, group, and broadcast chats for a user in the minimum time possible. The storage requirements can be met by both relational databases and NoSQL solutions, such as Amazon DynamoDB. We can identify relationships among the data, such as a message is associated with a user or group, a user can be part of one or more groups, a user is registered with a device, a user has a list of contacts, and so on. Both relational and NoSQL databases meet the storage requirements since the system doesn’t require any specific set of constraints offered by a particular database.

数据在数据库中的存储方式应当使读取非常快，也就是说，系统应当能够在尽可能短的时间内检索出某个用户的所有一对一、群组和广播聊天。关系数据库和 NoSQL 方案（例如 Amazon DynamoDB）都能满足这些存储需求。我们可以识别数据之间的关系，例如一条消息关联到某个用户或群组、一个用户可以属于一个或多个群组、一个用户在某台设备上注册、一个用户有一份联系人列表，等等。关系数据库和 NoSQL 数据库都能满足存储需求，因为系统并不要求某个特定数据库所提供的那一组特定约束。

One system requirement is deleting messages from the database once they are successfully delivered to users. The choice of database should be able to efficiently perform the deletion process. As pointed out in Chapter 18, data is not actually removed from the disk upon the delete operation but rather is cleaned with the help of regular vacuum processes. To manage the deletion process more effectively, we can

系统的一项需求是：消息一旦成功送达用户，就从数据库中删除。所选数据库应当能够高效地执行删除过程。正如第 18 章指出的那样，delete 操作并不会真正把数据从磁盘上移除，而是借助定期的 vacuum 清理过程来清理。为更有效地管理删除过程，我们可以

Page 531

try to figure out if data can be partitioned based on the time range so that the entire set of older data can be removed by deleting the partition. The key consideration for the chat application use case could be deleting the data at regular intervals, such as on a weekly or monthly basis, rather than firing the delete query for every message once it is delivered to the user. The deletion process should also take care of deleting unwanted media from the object storage. WhatsApp follows a rather simple architecture for transient message storage using the files—we’ll discuss this approach in later sections of this chapter.

尝试弄清是否可以按时间范围对数据进行分区，从而通过删除分区来移除整批较旧的数据。对于聊天应用这个用例，关键的考虑可能是按固定间隔（例如每周或每月）删除数据，而不是在每条消息送达用户时都发起一次 delete 查询。删除过程还应当负责从对象存储中删除不需要的媒体。WhatsApp 在临时消息存储上采用了一种相当简单的、基于文件的架构——我们将在本章后面的小节中讨论这种方法。

The message storage aspect is quite interesting in the case of group messaging. We mentioned that the system stores a copy of messages associated with a user and the user can fetch these messages once they are online, but is this really a requirement for group messaging? Keeping a copy of the same message for each user is overkill and requires much more storage space. Instead, the system should keep a single copy of a message in the context of a group, and the message ID (the unique identifier of the message) can be used as a reference for message sharing, much like media sharing. This consideration becomes critical if the messages are stored on the server forever, but the system proposed in this chapter can still live with it as the messages are stored only for the time that the users are not connected to the chat application.

在群组消息的情况下，消息存储这一面相当有意思。我们提到系统会为每个用户存储一份与其关联的消息副本，用户上线后可以拉取这些消息；但这对群组消息来说真的是必要的吗？为每个用户都保留同一条消息的一份副本是一种过度设计，需要多得多的存储空间。相反，系统应当在群组上下文中只保留一条消息的单份副本，而消息 ID（消息的唯一标识符）可以像媒体分享一样，被用作消息分享的引用。如果消息要永久存储在服务器上，这一考虑就变得至关重要；但本章提出的系统仍可以容忍这种做法，因为消息只在用户未连接聊天应用期间才被存储。

Now, let’s discuss multimedia management in the chat application.

现在，我们讨论聊天应用中的多媒体管理。

Multimedia system

The chat application supports image and video sharing along with texts. This can be managed by a completely independent component (a media service) to upload and download the media content, and the reference URL of the media can be used as part of messaging. For any request to share media content, the request is sent to the media service, and it returns a reference URL for where the image is uploaded (the same reference URL is used by recipients to download the media content). The reference URL is sent via text messaging following the same principles we discussed in “Direct messaging” on page 505.

聊天应用除文本外还支持图片和视频分享。这可以由一个完全独立的组件（媒体服务）来管理，负责上传和下载媒体内容，而媒体的引用 URL 可以作为消息的一部分。对于任何分享媒体内容的请求，请求都会被发送到媒体服务，媒体服务返回一个引用 URL，指明图片上传到了哪里（接收方使用同一个引用 URL 来下载媒体内容）。该引用 URL 通过文本消息发送，遵循我们在第 505 页“直接消息”中讨论过的相同原则。

Additionally, the media content is pushed to CDNs for faster downloads. On big events like sports events or holidays, it can absolutely happen that the same media content is forwarded by a wide range of users, and storing the content again and again requires a lot of storage space. Media compression is the first technique for saving storage space on devices and allows for faster download and uploads. The compression should not reduce the media quality drastically, and a balance should be kept between saving storage space and maintaining the quality of content.

此外，媒体内容会被推送到 CDN 以实现更快的下载。在体育赛事或节假日等重大事件中，完全可能出现同一份媒体内容被大量用户转发的情况，而一次次重复存储该内容会需要大量存储空间。媒体压缩是节省设备存储空间的第一项技术，并能让下载和上传更快。压缩不应大幅降低媒体质量，而应在节省存储空间与维持内容质量之间保持平衡。

To further optimize the overall systems, we can follow a simplistic approach to create a hash of media content before storing the image to object storage, such as Amazon S3. The system checks if a hash is already available in the media database and returns the already created reference URL if a hash is available. In case the hash is not

为进一步优化整体系统，我们可以采用一种简单的做法：在把图片存储到对象存储（例如 Amazon S3）之前，先对媒体内容创建一个哈希。系统检查该哈希是否已存在于媒体数据库中，如果哈希已存在，就返回已经创建好的引用 URL。如果哈希不存在

Page 532

present in the database, the system creates a media hash, uploads the media content to object storage, and returns the reference URL (after storing the media hash and reference URL in the database). The system puts a maximum limit on the size of content shared, but it could be the case that multiple short videos are created from the bigger video and are shared among the users. In this case, the computed hash will be different, and the system will store both the big video and the short videos created from the bigger video. A better approach here could be to divide the video into multiple chunks (such as 500 KB each) and then compare the chunks hash with already stored chunks in the data store. We’ll discuss breaking a larger video into smaller chunks more in Chapter 20.

于数据库中，系统就创建一个媒体哈希，把媒体内容上传到对象存储，并返回引用 URL（同时把媒体哈希和引用 URL 存入数据库）。系统对分享内容的大小设置了上限，但可能出现这样的情况：从一个较大视频中截出多个短视频，并在用户之间分享。在这种情况下，计算出的哈希会不同，系统就会同时存储大视频以及由它截出的短视频。这里一个更好的做法可能是把视频切分成多个块（例如每块 500 KB），然后把这些块的哈希与数据存储中已存储的块进行比较。我们将在第 20 章更详细地讨论把较大视频切分成更小块的做法。

The WhatsApp chat application is built in the Erlang programming language on top of Ejabberd open source software. Erlang is a functional programming language with built-in support of actors and is specifically designed to handle a huge number of concurrent connections. Let’s talk a little about the WhatsApp architecture with Erlang.

WhatsApp 聊天应用使用 Erlang 编程语言构建在 Ejabberd 开源软件之上。Erlang 是一种函数式编程语言，内置对 actor 的支持，专门为处理数量极其庞大的并发连接而设计。下面我们简单谈谈基于 Erlang 的 WhatsApp 架构。

WhatsApp Architecture with Erlang

Ejabberd is open source software specifically designed to support building near real-time chat applications. The software is built in Erlang and can be deployed as an XMPP server. Here is the list of features offered by Ejabberd out of the box, which also covers the defined functional requirements for our system:

Ejabberd 是一款开源软件，专门为支持构建近实时聊天应用而设计。该软件用 Erlang 编写，可以作为 XMPP 服务器部署。下面是 Ejabberd 开箱即用提供的功能列表，其中也涵盖了我们系统所定义的功能性需求：

  • Support for one-to-one and group messaging
    支持一对一消息和群组消息
  • Support for user last activity, user presence status, and typing indicator
    支持用户最后活跃时间、用户在线状态和“正在输入”指示
  • Support for the user’s contact list along with their presence status
    支持用户联系人列表及其在线状态
  • Support for message delivery receipts
    支持消息送达回执
  • Support for sharing media content such as images, videos, and the like
    支持分享图片、视频等媒体内容

Ejabberd offers a modular architecture and can easily be extended to meet any specific business requirements. Because Ejabberd is built on top of the Erlang programming language, it can use the language’s inherent support for message passing and concurrency. Ejabberd software can support more than two million concurrent users on a single machine, which is a great milestone and makes it ideal for managing large connection pools, saving the infrastructure costs. You can read additional use cases built on top of Ejabberd.

Ejabberd 提供模块化架构，可以轻松扩展以满足任何特定业务需求。由于 Ejabberd 构建在 Erlang 编程语言之上，它可以利用该语言对消息传递和并发的原生支持。Ejabberd 软件在单台机器上可以支持超过两百万并发用户，这是一个了不起的里程碑，也使其非常适合管理大型连接池，从而节省基础设施成本。你可以进一步阅读构建在 Ejabberd 之上的其他用例。

Erlang offers lightweight processes with very minimal resources as compared to processes from other programming languages. Most languages use the OS processes and threads for program execution, but Erlang creates its own independent processes in the user space that are not bound to kernel threads (or OS processes) in any way. Erlang uses BEAM (originally Bogdan’s Erlang Abstract Machine) as a VM to

Erlang 提供轻量进程，与其他编程语言的进程相比，其资源占用极少。大多数语言使用操作系统进程和线程来执行程序，但 Erlang 在用户空间中创建自己独立的进程，这些进程不以任何方式绑定到内核线程（或操作系统进程）。Erlang 使用 BEAM（最初 Bogdan’s Erlang Abstract Machine 的缩写）作为虚拟机（VM），来

Page 533

schedule and run the programs in the Erlang runtime environment. To compare BEAM with JVM, JVM maps its threads with the OS threads, and the OS takes the responsibility of thread scheduling. With Erlang, the scheduling is fully managed by BEAM to optimize the overall working of the system.

在 Erlang 运行时环境中调度和运行程序。把 BEAM 与 JVM 对比：JVM 把它的线程映射到操作系统线程，由操作系统负责线程调度；而在 Erlang 中，调度完全由 BEAM 管理，以优化系统的整体运行。

On top of all its other benefits, Erlang inherently supports hot-swap deployments, allowing users to upgrade the code without worrying about any impact. Hot-swap deployment means you can deploy new code on a production running server without any downtime or hampering the existing connections.

除了所有其他优点之外，Erlang 还原生支持热交换（hot-swap）部署，允许用户升级代码而不必担心任何影响。热交换部署意味着你可以在一台正在生产运行的服务器上部署新代码，而无需任何停机、也不会影响现有连接。

Now, let’s look at the overall system architecture of WhatsApp.

现在，我们来看 WhatsApp 的整体系统架构。

System architecture

The WhatsApp architecture is very similar to what we already went over in previous sections. User devices establish a session with the chat daemons (similar to the frontend service in “Direct messaging” on page 505) and web daemons managed by two separate frontend systems. Chat daemons are responsible for handling connections from mobile devices, and web daemons are responsible for handling connections from WhatsApp web clients. In addition to the two frontend systems, a separate system handles the media uploads and downloads from the users, and the media URL is used as a reference during chat communication. The chat and web daemons further connect with different backend Erlang clusters that are fully decoupled from one another to perform tasks like:

WhatsApp 架构与我们在前面几节中已经讲过的非常相似。用户设备与聊天守护进程（类似于第 505 页“直接消息”中的前端服务）以及 Web 守护进程建立会话，这两类守护进程由两个独立的前端系统管理。聊天守护进程负责处理来自移动设备的连接，Web 守护进程负责处理来自 WhatsApp Web 客户端的连接。除了这两个前端系统之外，还有一个独立系统负责处理用户的媒体上传和下载，媒体 URL 在聊天通信中被用作引用。聊天守护进程和 Web 守护进程进一步连接到不同的后端 Erlang 集群，这些集群彼此完全解耦，用于执行如下任务：

  • Connecting with the user service to authenticate the user
    连接用户服务以对用户进行认证
  • Connecting with the offline service to retrieve any messages pending for the user to be delivered
    连接离线服务，为用户检索任何待投递的消息

All the chat frontend nodes are fully interconnected with one another (fully mesh network topology), and messages are directly transferred between the users if they’re online, without the intervention of backend services. The mapping of users specific to the chat frontend server is maintained by the session service, and the user can reinitiate the connection in case the connection is dropped from either the user’s or the server’s end. Management of group relationships is handled by the group service, and push notifications are handled by the notification push service. The media servers are implemented on top of another Erlang open source software application, YAWS (Yet Another Web Server). The overall architecture is shown in Figure 19-4.

所有聊天前端节点彼此完全互连（全连接网络拓扑，fully mesh），如果用户在线，消息会在用户之间直接传输，而无需后端服务介入。会话服务维护着用户到具体聊天前端服务器的映射；如果连接在用户端或服务器端断开，用户可以重新发起连接。群组关系的管理由群组服务处理，推送通知由通知推送服务处理。媒体服务器构建在另一个 Erlang 开源软件应用 YAWS（Yet Another Web Server）之上。整体架构如图 19-4 所示。

Page 534

The multimedia system works similarly to what we discussed in the “Multimedia system” on page 510. We mentioned that the media content is deleted once the acknowledgment is received from all the recipients, but the WhatsApp system also configures some delay since there is always the possibility that once a user receives the images or video files, they will forward the messages to their friends and so on. Configuring some delay for deleting the media can save having to reupload it from the user devices and help optimize the overall performance of the system. This also saves bandwidth from the user’s end.

多媒体系统的工作方式与我们在第 510 页“多媒体系统”中讨论的类似。我们提到，一旦收到所有接收方的确认，媒体内容就会被删除；但 WhatsApp 系统还配置了一段延迟，因为总是存在这样的可能性：用户一旦收到图片或视频文件，就会把这些消息转发给他们的朋友，如此层层转发。为媒体删除配置一段延迟，可以避免从用户设备重新上传，并有助于优化系统的整体性能。这也节省了用户端的带宽。

There is a possibility that clients will drop off in the middle of the media-uploading process and therefore only parts of the media file are uploaded to the system. The multimedia system should keep a separate cleaning mechanism to clear out such files from the data store.
有可能客户端在媒体上传过程中途掉线，导致只有一部分媒体文件被上传到系统。多媒体系统应当保留一个独立的清理机制，把这类文件从数据存储中清除。

There are a lot of different kinds of mobile phones, and each one supports different formats of multimedia content. To ensure a good user experience, the multimedia system transcodes the media file into different formats (more on this in Chapter 20) and delivers it to the user based on their device.

手机种类繁多，每一种支持的多媒体内容格式也不同。为确保良好的用户体验，多媒体系统会把媒体文件转码成不同格式（第 20 章详述），并根据用户的设备向其投递。

Page 535

There are also database offerings that are exclusively written in Erlang. Let’s discuss use cases for Mnesia and other storage solutions that are used in the WhatsApp architecture.

也有一些专门用 Erlang 编写的数据库产品。下面我们讨论 Mnesia 以及 WhatsApp 架构中使用的其他存储方案的用例。

Databases

Mnesia is a relational database, and Erlang term storage (ETS) is an in-memory data store for faster lookups; both are purpose built for Erlang. WhatsApp heavily uses both these data stores for its storage requirements. Let’s discuss some of the benefits that Mnesia offers as compared to traditional relational databases like MySQL:

Mnesia 是一个关系数据库，而 Erlang term storage（ETS）是一个用于更快查找的内存数据存储；二者都是为 Erlang 量身打造的。WhatsApp 在其存储需求中大量使用这两种数据存储。下面我们讨论 Mnesia 相比 MySQL 等传统关系数据库所提供的一些好处：

  • If the application is written in Erlang, Mnesia offers real-time data lookup by allowing data storage in the same memory space as the application.
    如果应用是用 Erlang 编写的，Mnesia 通过允许数据存储在与应用相同的内存空间中，提供实时数据查找。
  • The data objects stored in the database and the Erlang application code are exactly the same, removing the need for data transformation.
    存储在数据库中的数据对象与 Erlang 应用代码中的对象完全相同，无需进行数据转换。
  • Mnesia allows dynamic reconfiguration of objects at runtime.
    Mnesia 允许在运行时对对象进行动态重配置。
  • The distributed nature of the Mnesia database provides high fault tolerance.
    Mnesia 数据库的分布式特性提供了高容错能力。

WhatsApp uses Mnesia as a data store to store all kinds of data, such as account and user profile information, group memberships, and media references and transcodings. WhatsApp deploys the database on the same cluster as the application code (note that they are moving to remote databases as part of the migration to Facebook infrastructure). Deployment of databases on the same instances as the application makes the system stateful and is generally not recommended to ensure easier recovery from system faults, but let’s talk about some of the benefits of databases and applications running on the same cluster instance.

WhatsApp 使用 Mnesia 作为数据存储来存储各种数据，例如账户和用户资料信息、群组成员关系，以及媒体引用和转码结果。WhatsApp 把数据库部署在与应用代码相同的集群上（注意：作为向 Facebook 基础设施迁移的一部分，他们正在转向远程数据库）。把数据库与应用部署在同一实例上会使系统有状态，通常不建议这样做，因为这不利于从系统故障中更容易地恢复；但下面我们谈谈数据库与应用运行在同一集群实例上的一些好处。

For an independent remote database, we need to handle connectivity between application code and the database layer as well as routing, failovers, consistency, and reduced infrastructure management. This is not much of a bottleneck because of multiple offerings by cloud providers and makes the management task a piece of cake. In the Erlang cluster, the data is stored in Mnesia in smaller parts called islands. An island is a set of hosts that all share one schema, and each island consists of data from two hosts to provide redundancy in the form of primary and secondary partitions. The partitioning of data is created based on key-to-node mapping, much like how it’s handled in Amazon DynamoDB based on the partition key, as shown in Figure 19-5.

对于独立的远程数据库，我们需要处理应用代码与数据库层之间的连接，以及路由、故障转移、一致性，并减少基础设施管理。由于云服务商提供了多种产品，这一点并不构成太大瓶颈，管理工作也变得轻而易举。在 Erlang 集群中，数据以更小的部分存储在 Mnesia 中，这些部分称为 island（岛）。一个 island 是一组主机，它们共享同一个 schema；每个 island 由来自两台主机的数据组成，以主分区和副分区的形式提供冗余。数据的分区是基于键到节点的映射创建的，很像 Amazon DynamoDB 中基于分区键的处理方式，如图 19-5 所示。

The partitions are managed by Erlang gen_server deployment. The Erlang gen_server module offers the base functionality of client-server architecture. The client calls the server via an API, and the server acts on the client request and responds.

这些分区由 Erlang gen_server 部署来管理。Erlang gen_server 模块提供了客户端-服务器架构的基础功能。客户端通过 API 调用服务器，服务器根据客户端请求采取行动并作出响应。

Page 536

In previous sections, we mentioned using transient stores to store messages and media content in case users are offline. The lifecycle of data on the transient store is managed via the offline service. We can utilize the object stores provided by the cloud providers to store this kind of data, such as Amazon S3, but in the case of WhatsApp, the entire data store is in house, managed on the SSD and spinning disks.

在前面几节中，我们提到在用户离线时使用临时存储来存储消息和媒体内容。临时存储上数据的生命周期由离线服务管理。我们可以利用云服务商提供的对象存储（例如 Amazon S3）来存储这类数据；但在 WhatsApp 的情况下，整个数据存储都是自建的，运行在 SSD 和机械磁盘上。

The storage drives are managed via the JBOD (Just a Bunch of Disks) system. JBOD allows multiple disks to be combined into one representation, and we can access the disks from the software as a single disk. Here are the implementation details for the transient message store:

存储驱动器通过 JBOD（Just a Bunch of Disks，磁盘簇）系统来管理。JBOD 允许多块磁盘组合成一个整体视图，软件可以像访问单块磁盘一样访问这些磁盘。下面是临时消息存储的实现细节：

  • The messages corresponding to a user are stored on an append-only file, and the file is deleted once the messages are delivered to the user. The AOF file is like a mailbox that holds letters until they are picked up. The AOF files are kept on the storage partition dedicated to a set of users.
    与某个用户对应的消息存储在一个只追加（append-only）文件中，一旦消息送达用户，该文件就被删除。AOF 文件就像一个邮箱，把信件保管到被取走为止。AOF 文件保存在专用于一组用户的存储分区上。
  • The media files are stored in the directories, and the references are maintained in the Mnesia database.
    媒体文件存储在目录中，其引用维护在 Mnesia 数据库中。
  • To ensure data redundancy, the data is stored on two parallel storage partitions.
    为确保数据冗余，数据存储在两个并行的存储分区上。

The messages are stored in two parallel files on the filesystem. Once the user comes back online, the offline system retrieves the file from both the storage partitions, combines the messages, removes any duplicates, and then sends the messages to the user’s device.

消息以两个并行文件的形式存储在文件系统上。一旦用户重新上线，离线系统就从两个存储分区中取出文件，合并消息，去除任何重复项，然后把消息发送到用户的设备。

Images are stored on the SSD for faster storage and retrieval, and videos are stored on the slower spinning disks. In case the images are not delivered to the recipients within a specific threshold timeframe, they are moved to a slower storage solution to optimize the overall storage costs. The references should be updated in the databases

图片存储在 SSD 上以实现更快的存储和检索，视频则存储在较慢的机械磁盘上。如果图片在某个特定阈值时间范围内尚未送达接收方，就会被迁移到更慢的存储方案，以优化整体存储成本。当文件从一个位置迁移到另一个位置时，数据库中的引用应当更新。

Page 537

when the files are moved from one location to another. As the messages are not persisted indefinitely at the server side, they are stored on the client device in a local SQLite database.

由于消息不会在服务器端无限期持久化，它们会存储在客户端设备本地的 SQLite 数据库中。

In the next section, we’ll design and deploy the chat application architecture on the AWS cloud.

在下一节中，我们将在 AWS 云上设计并部署聊天应用架构。

Launching the System on AWS

We discussed a couple of new concepts in this chapter around maintaining a persistent connection with user devices and offering near real-time behavior. In previous sections, we talked about a scalable architecture for designing a chat application, but we’ll start with a much simpler architecture in the Day 0 architecture, and later we’ll add enhancements. We’ll try to leverage fully managed services to reduce the time to market of the chat application. Later, we’ll figure out any potential bottlenecks and make amendments to the design to overcome those limitations.

我们在本章讨论了几个新概念，涉及与用户设备维持持久连接以及提供近实时行为。在前面几节中，我们谈到了用于设计聊天应用的可扩展架构，但我们在 Day 0 架构中会从一个简单得多的架构开始，之后再逐步增强。我们将尽量利用全托管服务来缩短聊天应用的上市时间。之后，我们会找出任何潜在瓶颈，并对设计做出修订以克服这些局限。

Day 0 Architecture

We explored AWS AppSync and the idea of fully managed, serverless WebSockets connections in Chapter 12. The chat application requires persistent bidirectional connections, and AppSync is a good candidate to facilitate this requirement. This feature allows us to remove any work related to managing the frontend service responsible for connection management. We skipped user signups and further authentication in the system design section—Amazon Cognito can be leveraged for this functionality. For signups specifically, the authentication is based on a one-time password (OTP) on mobile phones. This is not offered out of the box in Cognito, so we’ll need a custom implementation for this feature.

我们在第 12 章探讨了 AWS AppSync 以及全托管、无服务器 WebSocket 连接的理念。聊天应用需要持久的双向连接，AppSync 是满足这一需求的理想候选。这一特性使我们可以省去与管理负责连接管理的前端服务相关的任何工作。我们在系统设计部分跳过了用户注册和进一步的认证——这一功能可以利用 Amazon Cognito 来实现。具体到注册，认证基于手机上的一次性密码（OTP）。Cognito 并不开箱即用地提供这一功能，因此我们需要为该功能做定制实现。

To build the Day 0 architecture of the chat application, we can reference AWS shared blog posts on using AppSync and Amazon ElastiCache for Redis. Both of these posts include code samples for launching the application stack on the AWS cloud. The architecture with AppSync is illustrated in Figure 19-6. Users interact via Cognito for authentication, which then makes a user entry in the DynamoDB table. AppSync establishes a direct connection with databases to store message and media content via persistent WebSocket connections. We can create separate AWS Lambda handlers for managing information for groups, notifications, user contacts, and the like.

要构建聊天应用的 Day 0 架构，我们可以参考 AWS 上关于使用 AppSync 和使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 的公开博客文章。这两篇文章都包含在 AWS 云上启动应用栈的代码示例。使用 AppSync 的架构如图 19-6 所示。用户通过 Cognito 进行认证交互，随后在 DynamoDB 表中写入一条用户记录。AppSync 通过持久的 WebSocket 连接与数据库建立直接连接，以存储消息和媒体内容。我们可以创建独立的 AWS Lambda 处理器，用于管理群组、通知、用户联系人等信息。

Page 538

Figure 19-6 is a simplistic view of the deployment. The DynamoDB in the architecture proposes a multitable design (separate tables for storing users, messages, and groups) instead of the generally recommended single-table design to store all the entities. The DynamoDB multitable design (a separate table for each core entity in the GraphQL schema) is generally recommended for GraphQL implementations due to the fact that clients can fire arbitrary requests for data retrieval and the query access patterns are not entirely fixed. The GraphQL resolvers logic can become quite complex with the single-table design, but you can always choose a combination of both if that suits your requirements best.

图 19-6 是部署的一个简化视图。架构中的 DynamoDB 采用了多表设计（用不同的表分别存储用户、消息和群组），而不是通常推荐的用单表设计存储所有实体。DynamoDB 多表设计（为 GraphQL schema 中的每个核心实体单独建一张表）通常被推荐用于 GraphQL 实现，原因是客户端可以发起任意的数据检索请求，查询访问模式并不完全固定。在单表设计下，GraphQL 解析器（resolver）的逻辑会变得相当复杂；但如果最适合你的需求，你完全可以选择两者结合。

The Day 0 architecture we chose here is focused on using AWS-managed serverless services to reduce time to market and operational overhead. Evaluate open source software like Ejabberd for Day 0 architecture and deploying it on Amazon EC2 or containerization services.

我们在这里选择的 Day 0 架构聚焦于使用 AWS 托管的无服务器服务，以缩短上市时间并降低运维开销。你也可以评估 Ejabberd 等开源软件作为 Day 0 架构，并把它部署在 Amazon EC2 或容器化服务上。

To scale the system to a large set of concurrent users, we can always invest time in figuring out the challenges and fixing them. In the next section, we discuss such challenges and how we can resolve them to scale the system to millions and beyond.

要把系统扩展到大量并发用户，我们总是可以投入时间去弄清挑战并加以解决。在下一节中，我们讨论这类挑战，以及如何解决它们，从而把系统扩展到数百万乃至更大规模。

Scaling to Millions and Beyond

A chat application is a very user-heavy use case, and it should cater to an increasing user base without impacting the availability and performance of the app. The number of network connections is huge, so one important consideration in the architecture is congestion control. Congestion basically means the system is bombarded with more requests than it can actually handle, making the system use all of its resources

聊天应用是一个非常依赖用户量的用例，它应当在不影响应用可用性和性能的前提下，满足不断增长的用户群。网络连接数量巨大，因此架构中一个重要的考虑是拥塞控制。拥塞基本上意味着系统被超过其实际处理能力的请求所淹没，使系统耗尽所有资源

Page 539

without performing any actual work of serving the requests. This situation is similar to road traffic: the actual distance covered by a vehicle reduces as the number of vehicles on the road increases.

却没有真正做任何服务请求的工作。这种情况类似于道路交通：随着道路上车辆数量增加，一辆车实际行驶的距离反而缩短。

Congestion handling

Here are some mechanisms that are useful for detecting and controlling the congestion problem:

下面是一些有助于检测和控制拥塞问题的机制：

Graceful degradation

Once the system realizes it’s not possible to serve all the requests successfully, it should be able to drop some of the requests to clear the clutter. The mechanism of dropping the requests can vary from use case to use case; the system can discard all the new requests or discard the older requests based on some set expiration. It is always better to serve some requests than to serve nothing at all.

一旦系统意识到无法成功服务所有请求，它就应当能够丢弃其中一些请求，以清理拥堵。丢弃请求的机制因用例而异；系统可以丢弃所有新请求，或者基于某个设定的过期时间丢弃较旧的请求。能服务一部分请求，总比完全什么都不服务要好。

You might have seen dog photos on amazon.com whenever Amazon is unable to fulfill a request—this is one way to return a custom error page if the system is overloaded with user requests. In the context of AWS services, the rate limiting on specific thresholds can be implemented with the help of AWS WAF. The system should be able to knock out malicious unwanted traffic, which can be done with tools like AWS WAF and AWS Shield.

当 Amazon 无法满足某个请求时，你可能在 amazon.com 上看到过狗狗照片——这就是一种在系统被用户请求压垮时返回自定义错误页面的方式。在 AWS 服务的语境下，可以借助 AWS WAF 实现针对特定阈值的限流。系统应当能够击退恶意的、不需要的流量，这可以用 AWS WAF 和 AWS Shield 等工具来完成。

Retry, but not too much

Both client applications and users use retry as a common solution if there’s no response within a certain time frame or if they receive an error response from the server application. Users do this by refreshing the browser web page. To avoid a storm of retries, the client should be informed with proper error message details to determine if it’s worth retrying the request. Further, the retry should be allowed based on the number of successful requests—for example, only allow one retry if there are one hundred successful requests (retries just with exponential backoffs are not helpful in these scenarios). Another mechanism for independent processing of requests could be decoupling systems by introducing a queue in between, such as SQS. This enables producers to publish requests and consumers to consume the requests at their own rates without overloading the system.

如果在某个时间范围内没有收到响应，或者从服务器应用收到错误响应，客户端应用和用户都会把重试当作常见的解决办法。用户的做法是刷新浏览器网页。为避免重试风暴，应当用恰当的错误详情告知客户端，让它判断是否值得重试该请求。此外，应当基于成功请求的数量来允许重试——例如，每成功一百次请求才允许重试一次（在这类场景下，仅仅用指数退避的重试并无帮助）。另一种独立处理请求的机制是在系统之间引入队列（例如 SQS）来解耦。这使得生产者可以发布请求，消费者按自己的速率消费请求，而不会压垮系统。

System testing

The system should be tested for its functionality beyond the expected load, and there should be proper operational mechanisms (metrics, alarms, dashboards, and runbooks) set up to identify and fix the issues. The system should also be chaos tested with tools like Amazon FIS to identify any loopholes in worst-case scenarios, such as an entire AZ going down or CPU utilization bumping to 100%.

应当在超出预期负载的情况下测试系统的功能，并且应当建立恰当的运维机制（指标、告警、仪表盘和运维手册），以发现并修复问题。还应当使用 Amazon FIS 等工具对系统进行混沌测试，以发现最坏情况下的任何漏洞，例如整个可用区（AZ）宕机，或 CPU 利用率飙升到 100%。

We used AWS AppSync for managing WebSocket connections in the Day 0 architecture. Per the AWS documentation, there is no hard limit on the number of WebSocket

我们在 Day 0 架构中使用 AWS AppSync 来管理 WebSocket 连接。根据 AWS 文档，WebSocket

Page 540

connections, and it should scale with the increasing scale. There are some other AWS services offering WebSocket support; let’s discuss them in the next section.

连接的数量没有硬性上限，它应当随规模增长而扩展。还有其他一些 AWS 服务也提供 WebSocket 支持，我们在下一节讨论。

WebSocket management services

AWS has enabled the WebSocket feature in multiple AWS services. The other options apart from AppSync for managing WebSockets are Amazon API Gateway, AWS IoT Core, and load balancer services. Some key considerations in the context of building chat applications are listed in Table 19-1.

AWS 已经在多个 AWS 服务中启用了 WebSocket 功能。除 AppSync 之外，管理 WebSocket 的其他选择还有 Amazon API Gateway、AWS IoT Core 以及负载均衡器服务。表 19-1 列出了构建聊天应用时的一些关键考虑。

Key factorAmazon API GatewayAWS IoT CoreELB
DefinitionCreates and manages REST, HTTP, and WebSocket APIs at any scaleEnables IoT devices to securely connect with cloud applications and other devicesDistributes incoming traffic across multiple targets (revisit Chapter 9 for more about ELB and API Gateway)
Support for persistent connectionsWebSocket APIs supportMQTT over WebSocket supportBoth ALB and NLB allow a connection upgrade to the WebSocket type

表 19-1. API Gateway、IoT Core 与 ELB 对比：

There are many other differences between these services, and they offer different benefits. Review the updated guidance on their product pages to help you determine if they meet your business requirements. For a scale as big as WhatsApp, consider managing the system on your own to gain more control over your configurations than you would have with managed services.

这些服务之间还有许多其他差异，它们提供不同的好处。请在各自产品页面上查阅最新指南，以帮助判断它们是否满足你的业务需求。对于像 WhatsApp 这样大的规模，建议考虑自行管理系统，以比使用托管服务获得对配置更大的控制权。

AppSync doesn’t have any server management overhead, so we don’t have to worry about scaling up and down. In case we decide to deploy a frontend service to manage the WebSocket connections, we should come up with our ideal instance configurations and the maximum number of connections that can be supported by one instance. The best approach for estimating this number is load testing the system and accordingly tuning the configurations.

AppSync 没有任何服务器管理开销，因此我们不必担心扩缩容。如果我们决定部署一个前端服务来管理 WebSocket 连接，就应当确定理想的实例配置，以及单台实例最多能支持的连接数。估算这个数字的最佳方法是对系统进行负载测试，并据此调优配置。

We discussed the idea of multiregion deployments in Chapter 16, and this becomes important for chat application scale as well. Let’s discuss the messaging architecture in the context of systems deployed in multiple regions.

我们在第 16 章讨论了多区域部署的理念，这一点对于聊天应用的扩展同样重要。下面我们在多区域部署系统的语境下讨论消息架构。

Multiregion deployment of messaging systems

With multiregion deployment, users communicating with one another can be located in different regions and connected to separate regions. For such use cases, interregion communication should be incorporated in a latency-effective manner. AWS regions are connected with one another on a dedicated network, so we don’t have to worry

在多区域部署下，相互通信的用户可能位于不同区域、连接到不同区域。对于这类用例，跨区域通信应当以低延迟的方式纳入。AWS 各个区域之间通过专用网络彼此连接，因此我们不必担心

Page 541

about handling the region connectivity infrastructure. Chapter 16 focused on the idea that the data of all the users is replicated in the regions, but we may choose to optimize to store user data in only two regions (for redundancy and handling regional failures) instead of all of them. This means that data should be sent to another region for serving the user query because the data is not locally persisted.

处理区域连接基础设施。第 16 章聚焦于这样一种理念：所有用户的数据都在各区域间复制；但我们可以选择优化，只把用户数据存储在两个区域（用于冗余和应对区域故障），而不是所有区域。这意味着为服务用户查询，数据应当被发送到另一个区域，因为数据并没有在本地持久化。

Let’s take an example of one-to-one messaging between two users located in different geographies: chat servers will connect them to different regional servers. Here are two mechanisms we can explore for connectivity across the regions:

让我们举一个位于不同地理位置的两个用户之间一对一消息的例子：聊天服务器会把他们连接到不同区域的服务器。下面是我们可以探索的两种跨区域连接机制：

  • The send message notification (message from user A to user B) is published to every region; the consumer in every region figures out if the intended recipient belongs to the region. If yes, then it will deliver the message if the user is online or persist the message to the offline system for future delivery.
    发送消息通知（从用户 A 发往用户 B 的消息）被发布到每个区域；每个区域的消费者判断预期接收方是否属于本区域。如果是，就在用户在线时投递消息，或者把消息持久化到离线系统以便日后投递。
  • A global data store is used for ElastiCache Redis for session service. The global data store helps figure out the exact region a user is connected to, and a message is sent to a specific region only.
    为会话服务使用一个基于 ElastiCache Redis 的全局数据存储。全局数据存储帮助确定用户确切连接到哪个区域，消息只被发送到该特定区域。

For either of these two approaches to work, we need a user registry to figure out the primary region for a user; this is also important for handling offline-user message delivery. We can very well leverage DynamoDB global tables for this use case.

要让这两种方案中的任何一种奏效，我们都需要一个用户注册表来确定用户的主区域；这对于处理离线用户的消息投递也很重要。我们完全可以为这个用例利用 DynamoDB 全局表。

To summarize, we recommend using a global data store for ElastiCache to figure out a user’s region if the user is online and deliver the message directly. If a user is not found, use DynamoDB to identify the user region, and the message is handled by the offline system.

总结一下：我们建议使用一个基于 ElastiCache 的全局数据存储，在用户在线时确定其所在区域并直接投递消息。如果找不到该用户，就用 DynamoDB 识别用户所在区域，消息则由离线系统处理。

With this understanding, let’s move to the Day N architecture.

有了这些理解，下面我们进入 Day N 架构。

Day N Architecture

Figure 19-4 shows the WhatsApp architecture, a very simple architecture that is able to serve billions of messages every day. The infrastructure is managed in house and deployed on bare-metal servers.

图 19-4 展示了 WhatsApp 架构——一个非常简单、却能够每天服务数十亿条消息的架构。其基础设施是自建管理的，部署在裸金属服务器上。

We’ll try to leverage AWS components to deploy the systems and meet the data storage requirements. The architecture uses Amazon ECS for deploying services, and we use DynamoDB as a database in most of the applications. As mentioned in “Message storage” on page 509, both relational and nonrelational databases meet the system requirements, and you can choose a solution based on previous expertise. Aurora Serverless Limitless Database discussed in Chapter 18 is one option for managed relational databases, but you should definitely consider managing the database on your own for fine-tuning of configurations at WhatsApp scale. Figure 19-7 illustrates what our own chat app architecture might look like when deployed on the AWS cloud.

我们将尽量利用 AWS 组件来部署系统并满足数据存储需求。该架构使用 Amazon ECS 部署服务，在大多数应用中使用 DynamoDB 作为数据库。正如第 509 页“消息存储”中提到的，关系数据库和非关系数据库都能满足系统需求，你可以基于以往的经验选择一种方案。第 18 章讨论的 Aurora Serverless Limitless Database 是托管关系数据库的一个选择，但在 WhatsApp 这样的规模下，为了对配置进行精细调优，你绝对应当考虑自己管理数据库。图 19-7 展示了我们自己的聊天应用架构部署在 AWS 云上时可能的样子。

Page 542

Here’s a summary of the different components from the system architecture:

下面是系统架构中各个组件的总结：

Frontend system

Gateway layer for user connections. It works in conjunction with the session manager system to store user device connectivity information with available servers.

用户连接的网关层。它与会话管理器系统协同工作，把用户设备的连接信息与可用服务器一起存储。

Page 543

Multimedia system

Uses a combination of Amazon S3 and Amazon CloudFront for media storage and caching capabilities. The multimedia system also uses DynamoDB to store the metadata of media content. The multimedia system works like the video-ingestion pipeline that we will discuss in Chapter 20 for content ingestion into the system and then delivery to users in an efficient manner.

结合使用 Amazon S3 和 Amazon CloudFront，提供媒体存储和缓存能力。多媒体系统还使用 DynamoDB 存储媒体内容的元数据。多媒体系统的工作方式类似于我们将在第 20 章讨论的视频摄入流水线（video-ingestion pipeline），用于把内容摄入系统，然后以高效方式投递给用户。

User service

Responsible for user authentication and maintaining account information.

负责用户认证和维护账户信息。

Notification system

Delivers notifications to user devices for new messages by using Amazon SNS. Amazon SNS sends the notification to Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) servers for Android devices and Apple Push Notification (APN) servers for Apple devices. We’ve kept a very simplistic view of the notification service to limit the scope of this chapter; read company engineering blogs on this topic (e.g., Uber’s blog post on optimization of push notifications) to see how it works at a huge scale.

使用 Amazon SNS 向用户设备投递新消息通知。Amazon SNS 把通知发送给 Android 设备的 Firebase Cloud Messaging（FCM）服务器，以及 Apple 设备的 Apple Push Notification（APN）服务器。为限制本章范围，我们对通知服务只做了非常简化的描述；请阅读各公司关于这一主题的工程博客（例如 Uber 关于推送通知优化的博客文章），看看它在超大规模下是如何工作的。

Offline system

Stores and manages the message when the user device is not connected to the frontend system.

在用户设备未连接到前端系统时，存储并管理消息。

Groups manager system

Maintains all the group-related information and delivers messages to group members.

维护所有与群组相关的信息，并把消息投递给群组成员。

The logging and monitoring components are not shown in the architecture diagram, but having them in place is important. We can leverage AWS services like Amazon CloudWatch for storing logs and set up metrics and alerts for visualization and health monitoring.

日志和监控组件没有在架构图中画出，但把它们配备到位非常重要。我们可以利用 Amazon CloudWatch 等 AWS 服务来存储日志，并设置指标和告警，用于可视化和健康监控。

Conclusion

The WhatsApp architecture is based on one simple principle: “just enough engineering.” Simple architectures scale well and require fewer people to manage the systems and the underlying infrastructure. To start with—as we’ve done in previous chapters—we recommend leveraging cloud provider services to launch and manage the solutions, which can reduce the overall time to market. You can move to different solutions if the need arises.

WhatsApp 架构基于一个简单的原则：“刚刚好的工程”（just enough engineering）。简单的架构扩展性好，并且只需要更少的人来管理系统和底层基础设施。作为起步——正如我们在前面几章中所做的那样——我们建议利用云服务商的服务来启动和管理解决方案，这可以缩短整体上市时间。如果需要，你可以再迁移到不同的方案。

The choice of language, networking protocol, and implementation paradigm is important for large-scale applications and should be carefully evaluated before application launch. Moving from one programming language to another can prove to be a big pain point once the system is already serving a large user base—it can definitely

对大规模应用而言，语言、网络协议和实现范式的选择非常重要，应当在应用上线之前仔细评估。一旦系统已经服务于庞大的用户群，从一种编程语言迁移到另一种可能被证明是一个巨大的痛点——这当然可以

Page 544

be achieved, but it’s much easier to take that into consideration from the start (with whatever data points you have at that time).

做到，但从一开始就把它考虑进去（哪怕用你当时手头有的任何数据点）要容易得多。

Load testing and chaos engineering are important techniques for figuring out system bottlenecks and identifying system limits. Keep metrics and alarms from day one to monitor system performance. System CPU utilization being at 100% doesn’t mean the system is always busy working; there is the possibility of congestion as well, so load testing always helps to decipher these scenarios.

负载测试和混沌工程是找出系统瓶颈、识别系统极限的重要技术。从第一天起就保留指标和告警，以监控系统性能。系统 CPU 利用率达到 100% 并不意味着系统一直在忙；也有可能是出现了拥塞，因此负载测试总是有助于解读这些场景。

In this chapter, we started talking about uploading video and transcoding it to different formats. We’ll discuss this in much more detail in the next chapter.

在本章中，我们开始谈到上传视频并将其转码为不同格式。我们将在下一章中更详细地讨论这一点。
